findings.claim: D1.2 listed packaged workers as an input without a preceding deliverable.
findings.evidence: D1.1 delivered the V2 plugin while D1.2 delivered both native drivers.
findings.suggested_fix: Assign worker module, entry point, package, lockfile and image handoffs to existing tasks.

findings.claim: AUTH-3 could miss a stale helper rewriting the underlying credential store.
findings.evidence: The recipient and A-bound resume rejection can use cached memory.
findings.suggested_fix: After the old helper settles, independently reopen the fixture store and verify only B or signed-out.

findings.claim: Build controls could mutate the frozen candidate.
findings.evidence: UI-1 requests incremental and failed builds although later scenarios require original artifact hashes.
findings.suggested_fix: Use separate copies and target directories for both build controls and verify original digests.
